mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Shen could not Shield his allies. Darkness has won this day.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Twilight Assault Slow</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is slowed while running away from Shen.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Twilight Assault</titleLeft><mainText>Shen's attacks will deal bonus damage based on the target's max health.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Empowered Twilight Assault</titleLeft><mainText>Shen's attacks will deal significant bonus damage based on target max health and have extra attack speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shen must prevent Zed from using the full power of the shadows. Damage and take him down before he can kill @spell.ZedPassive:ShenZedQuestKillCount@ nearby allies.

"Zed is too far gone. I will stand against his shadows."

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Recalling Spirit Blade</titleLeft><mainText>Shen is recalling his spirit blade in order to draw and wield it.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shen has defeated Zed, protecting allies and restoring harmony to the battlefield.

The Shield from Ki Barrier is now 30% stronger.

"No mourning Zed. I press on, empowered by the spirits I've saved."

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers @EnergyRefund@ Energy.

Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for @CCDuration@ seconds and dealing @TauntDamage@ physical damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Shadow Dash</titleLeft><mainText>Shen is dashing and will taunt enemy champions he collides with.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shen gains @ShieldValue@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds after using an Ability. This effect has a @ShieldCooldown@ second Cooldown, reduced by @ShieldCooldownReduction@ seconds when one of Shen's Abilities successfully affects an ally or enemy.

Shen has a Spirit Blade that his other Abilities use.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ki Barrier</titleLeft><mainText>Shen is blocking damage with a shield he generated by casting spells.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shen recalls his Spirit Blade. Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by @Effect4Amount@% while moving away from Shen for the next @Effect5Amount@ seconds.

Additionally, Shen's next @Effect3Amount@ Attacks deal an additional @BaseFlatDamage@ plus @BasePercentHealth@ max Health magic damage. If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade, the damage is increased to @BaseFlatDamage@ plus @EmpPercentHealth@ max Health magic damage and he gains @Effect9Amount@% Attack Speed for those Attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Each Attack deals @Effect1Amount*100@% increased damage to jungle monsters (max @Effect7Amount@ damage).
Attacks against structures deal @TowerDamageCalc@ damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between <shield>@Shield@</shield> and <shield>@MaxShield@ Shield</shield> based on their missing Health for @ShieldDuration@ seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for @ChannelDuration@ seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his <keywordMajor>Spirit Blade</keywordMajor>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Stand United Channel</titleLeft><mainText>Shen is channeling to teleport to the targeted ally.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Stand United Shield</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is being shielded by Shen.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Stand United Target</titleLeft><mainText>Shen is channeling in order to teleport to this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for @Effect1Amount@ seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked.

If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to @Effect2Amount@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Spirit's Refuge Active</titleLeft><mainText>Shen's spirit blade is blocking attacks that would hit nearby friendly champions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Spirit's Refuge Protection</titleLeft><mainText>Attacks that would hit this unit are blocked.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Spirit's Refuge Pending</titleLeft><mainText>Shen's Spirit's Refuge will begin if Shen or an allied champion gets in the zone (or if enough time passes).</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
